The '''DCJ-45 repulsorlift generator''' was a model of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] used by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] in the manufacture of some of their ships, such as the [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]]. With DCJ-45 generators, skyhoppers were able to fly 300 km high and had excellent maneuverability.<ref name="EGVV" />
